quests.title: Get to know Ana
quests.summary: Ana owns the house you live in, but you hardly know her. Spend some time with her.

steps.hint: Find Ana at home and have a real conversation with her. Helping around the house (the dishes) counts too.

quests.title: The Plumber
quests.summary: Something is wrong in Ana's kitchen. A plumber is expensive... but maybe you can help.

steps.text: Ask Ana if something is wrong
steps.hint: Ana is often in the living room in the morning. Click her and ask if something is wrong.
The General Store in the Mall sells tools. It costs about $90.
Go to the kitchen with your toolkit. You need to be clever enough to do this.

action.title: Fix the kitchen pipes
action.label: quest_plumber_fix
action.fail_text: You look at the pipes and have no idea where to start. You need the right tools and a clearer head.

reward.message: Ana is grateful. Something has changed between you.

quests.title: A Thousand Dollars
quests.summary: Ana is selling her furniture. Something is wrong, and she is too proud to say it.

steps.hint: Talk games and washing the dishes bring you closer. Keep going every day.

steps.text: Find out why Ana is selling her things
steps.hint: Look for Ana at home and ask her about the furniture.

steps.text: Get $1000 and give it to Ana
steps.hint: Earn the money (Snapjob gigs pay well). When you have $1000, talk to Ana: the choice to give it to her appears.

reward.message: Ana opens a Supernova account. From now on she may let you take her photo when she is in a good mood.

quests.title: First steps in photography
quests.summary: Snapjob clients pay for simple photos. Start with the easy gigs.

steps.hint: Open Snapjob on your phone, choose a gig, take the photo in the right place and upload it.

reward.message: Snapjob bonus: $50 for your first three gigs.
